lines.en: I float in the air, turning slowly.
I drift over, light trailing behind.
I head for somewhere darker.
Two blocks up, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我慢慢飘到洞的另一边。
lines.en: I drift to the other side of the cave.
I turn and my light sweeps the wall.
I float across rubble.
I advance inside the shadow.
I drift without a sound.
I lower my height a little.
I float up along the rock wall.
I go around your torch.
I wind down in layers.
My light circles across the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我没有瞳孔，也没有方向。
lines.en: I have no pupil and no direction.
I rotate once in midair.
My light stains the stone blue.
I wait for my master to speak.
I watch straight ahead, silent.
A sheen of color plays on my surface.
I turn slowly and evenly.
My light circles across the stone wall
My light dims, then returns.

lines.zh: 我在他身边绕了一小圈。
lines.en: I circle once around him.

lines.zh: 我浮着，像挂在空中的灯。
lines.en: I hang like a lamp in the air.
I draw my light inward.
I have stayed right here, waiting.
My light falls on you.
I turn your way.
In truth I cannot see you.
You are lit very clearly.

lines.zh: 我停在离你两格的地方。
lines.en: I stop two blocks from you.

lines.zh: 我的光一暗，洞里更黑了。
lines.en: My light dims and the cave darkens.
I was sent to keep watch on you.
I am not frightening by myself.

lines.zh: 我的光照出你脸上的汗。
lines.en: My light picks out the sweat on your face.

lines.zh: 我对着你，像一盏盯人的灯。
lines.en: I face you like a lamp that stares.

lines.zh: 你走到哪边，我都转过去。
lines.en: Whichever way you go, I turn.

lines.zh: 我映出你的样子在表面。
lines.en: Your shape shows on my surface.

lines.zh: 这只巨眼没视力，撞偏了。
lines.en: This giant eye has no sight — it veered off.
A crack runs across my surface.
I shudder and light up again.
My light weakens.
I drift back two blocks.
My iridescence scatters.
I cannot make a sound.
I slowly gather my light again.
I have no mouth and no stomach.

lines.zh: 我围着那东西转了整圈。
lines.en: I circle the thing completely.
My light falls on it.
I give it a light nudge.
It means nothing to me.
I have no sight, but I can smell it.
I go back to watching you.
I follow only my master's orders.
I sweep it with light.
I need no reward.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像碰到一团光。
lines.en: You hit me like a patch of light.
I wobble; my light scatters and reforms.
A sheen of color rubs off on you.
I retreat a block and realign.
You reach, and I slip between your fingers.
A light flares between us.
You knock me off my heading.
I hardly care.
I drift slowly back to position.
Two eyes hang side by side.
Our lights join into one ring.
We start turning together.
Its light is paler than mine.
We shine on each other once.

lines.zh: 我们一起望同一个方向。
lines.en: We gaze the same way together.
We draw close and do not touch.
Our iridescence mingles.
We float up together.
Neither of us has a pupil.
I let it float in my light.
It turns near me.
My light shines right through it.
I lift it a little.
I release it and it falls.
I push it along.
I only light it, nothing more.
It rests at the edge of my light.
I deliver it to my master's feet.
My light settles on you.
I begin floating your way.
My light turns whiter.
I drift behind you.
I shine too bright to look at.

lines.zh: 我的光扫过你站的地方。
lines.en: My glow sweeps the spot where you stand.
I stop drifting.
I gather all my light into a beam.

lines.zh: 我把主人的敌人都照出来。
lines.en: I light up my master's enemies.
My light begins to pulse.

lines.zh: 我升到比他更高的位置。
lines.en: I rise above him.

lines.zh: 洞里的阴影都往我这边收。
lines.en: The cave's shadows draw toward me.
I hang above your flank.
Where you walk, the light follows.
I keep shining on your back.
I neither close in nor leave.
You go into the dark and I follow.

lines.zh: 我的光让洞里没有阴影。
lines.en: My light leaves no shadow in the cave.
I do not even hum.
I keep this path lit.
I drift slowly toward your face.

lines.zh: 我一直没有离开这条线。
lines.en: I have never left this line.

lines.zh: 你听见一声很低的光响。
lines.en: You hear a faint ringing of light.

lines.zh: 我照着你的手，不照别的。
lines.en: I light your hands and nothing else.
I am in the direction you mean to go.
I shine straight into your eyes.
My light burns once.
I bump into your chest.
I press down, blindingly bright.
The glare makes you stagger.
I swing in front and shine again.
I knock against your armor.
You raise a hand against the glare.
I withdraw and the light remains.
I am only shining, yet it hurts.
A point of light appears in the air.
I rise from his palm.
The cave glows blue.
I spin once as I appear.
You hear one faint tone.
My iridescence spreads on the wall first.
I settle beside him.
This place should be dark.
I begin hanging at this level.

lines.zh: 我的光把你的影子推开。
lines.en: My light pushes your shadow back.
Two eyes light up together.
Something flashes at the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 我的彩光把岩壁照得发亮。
lines.en: My iridescence brightens the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我成形时没有半点声响。
lines.en: I took shape without a whisper.
My light turns red in the fire.

lines.zh: 我从半空掉下来，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I drop from the air and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水把我包住，光散在水里。
lines.en: Water closes around me and my light spreads in it.
The blast's glare overwhelms mine.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，光从洞里漏出去。
lines.en: An arrow pierces me and light leaks out.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的光定住。
lines.en: That force freezes my light.
I do not hunger; I only dim.

lines.zh: 雷光与我混在一起，看不出来。
lines.en: The lightning glare merges with mine.

lines.zh: 我掉进黑暗里，什么也照不到。
lines.en: I fall into darkness and light nothing.
